description:
Title: Becoming A Parent

Create a process that support in planning, taking and extending a maternity leave.  
* Fetch information about potential models (months duration, split between parents) 
* Let parent select 
* Collect relevant information 
* Notify Social Security, Company in time 
* Gather information from companies 
* At the end of the period let parent decide about extension.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BecomingAParent"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LeaveNotification" name="Leave notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyInformation" name="Company information"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ParentProcess" name="Becoming a Parent" processRef="Process_BecomingAParent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Leave notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompany" name="Leave notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Participant_Company" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyInformation" name="Company information" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" messageRef="Message_CompanyInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming a Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Planning maternity leave begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_FetchInformation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchInformation" name="Fetch information about leave models">
      <bpmn:documentation>Include potential leave durations in months and how leave may be split between parents.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_FetchInformation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fetch_Select</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectModel" name="Select leave model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fetch_Select</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_NotifySplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifySplit" name="Notify both">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_NotifySplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifySocialSecurity</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyCompany</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security in time" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifySocialSecurity</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SocialSecurity_NotifyJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCompany" name="Notify company in time" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyCompany</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_NotifyJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifyJoin" name="Notifications sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SocialSecurity_NotifyJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_NotifyJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyJoin_Gather</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from company" messageRef="Message_CompanyInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyJoin_Gather</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Gather_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideExtension" name="At the end of the leave period, decide whether to extend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Gather_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decide_Extend</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decide_NoExtension</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extend leave?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decide_Extend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decide_NoExtension</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Extension_Requested</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Extension_NotRequested</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ExtensionRequested" name="Extension requested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Extension_Requested</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoExtension" name="Leave not extended">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Extension_NotRequested</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_FetchInformation" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_FetchInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fetch_Select" sourceRef="Task_FetchInformation" targetRef="Task_SelectModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Collect" sourceRef="Task_SelectModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_NotifySplit" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_NotifySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySocialSecurity" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyCompany" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SocialSecurity_NotifyJoin" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_NotifyJoin" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyJoin_Gather" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Decide" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Task_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Extend" name="Extend" sourceRef="Task_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_NoExtension" name="Do not extend" sourceRef="Task_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Extension_Requested" name="Extension requested" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_ExtensionRequested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Extension_NotRequested" name="No extension" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoExtension"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
